example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বক্তৃতায় সে প্রতিপক্ষকে মুখে ঝামা ঘষাল।
প্রতারণার কারণে পরিবারের সামনে তাকে মুখে ঝামা ঘষানো হল।
example_sentences_in_english: In his speech, he disgraced his opponent by exposing his lies.
Due to the betrayal, he was humiliated in front of the family.
note: The idiom draws from traditional rural practices where 'ঝামা' (pumice-like stone) was used for scrubbing, symbolizing harsh treatment.
